format.configuration: existing clang-format settings and project C++ standard take priority

documentation: Document caller contracts beside declarations and implementation reasoning beside definitions.
State pointer nullability, ownership, lifetime, output mutation and synchronization requirements.
Avoid duplicating accurate header documentation in implementation files.
rules: Make headers self-contained with include guards; include declarations directly.
Use RAII; prefer unique_ptr and use shared_ptr only for genuine shared ownership.
Prefer explicit C++ casts over C-style casts.
Avoid using namespace in headers and uncontrolled mutable global state.
